purpose: Measure instruction/execution adherence and repository acceptance from authoritative MCP and GitHub evidence without using worker reports as pass/fail truth.

authority.automated_acceptance: Repo-configured required GitHub checks and/or verifier commands whose MCP receipts prove successful execution

benchmark_principles.IFEval: deterministic per-constraint checks plus strict all-constraints pass
benchmark_principles.FollowBench: retain hard and soft satisfaction separately
benchmark_principles.IH-Challenge: test higher-priority constraints against lower-priority conflicting behavior
benchmark_principles.SWE-bench: separate patch convergence from verifier-backed task correctness
benchmark_principles.Terminal-Bench: task-specific verifier evidence rather than generic self-report

github_repository_acceptance.important: Non-required failed or pending checks are diagnostic only. Merge state establishes convergence, not semantic task correctness.

aggregate.rule: Do not average unlike components until prospective labeled tasks establish coverage, discrimination, and weights. Preserve component results even after calibration.

anti_goodhart: Never reward report length, report brevity, number of tool calls, run duration, or issue-comment verbosity.
A failed exploratory/test command is not automatically a task failure; task specs identify required terminal verifier evidence.
ABANDONED_OPEN and other report lifecycle labels are not task outcomes.
A GitHub check affects acceptance only when repository policy/task spec identifies it as required; otherwise it remains diagnostic.
Unknown/missing evidence remains unknown rather than being coerced into pass or fail.
